description:
# Professional Description

Stewart Richardson Deposition Services is Indiana's largest court reporting company, offering comprehensive legal support services including expert court reporting by NCRA certified professionals, high-quality legal video production by Certified Legal Video Specialists, and fully equipped video conferencing and deposition suites. With over 35 years of experience and six locations across Indiana, they distinguish themselves through personalized service, cutting-edge technology, and a team of over 35 dedicated court reporters committed to delivering accurate transcripts and consistent, professional video documentation. Their reputation for integrity, reliability, and flexibility—built through partnership with the National Network Reporting Company—makes them a trusted partner for litigation support across the Midwest and beyond.
